title: We have to develop our own AI layer for military services: Defence Secretary
description: India is restructuring its defense framework by developing a military Artificial Intelligence layer and scaling up missile production. The Integrated Air Command and Control System is being fully networked across platforms to enhance air defense. While legacy systems are upgraded, older platforms are now useful against drone warfare. Defence officials are prioritizing indigenous ballistic missile production to reduce costs.

title: Study highlights gender gap in AI media coverage in Spain
description: A media "glass ceiling" exists in news stories on artificial intelligence (AI) published in Spanish media in recent years: men are the main subjects in 41% of news reports, compared to just 5% featuring women. This is one of the findings of the report "InfoIA: Analysis of Information on Artificial Intelligence Published in Digital Media," conducted by the University Institute of Gender Studies at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M).
